content: Employees may book economy airfare. Manager approval is required for trips over $2,000. Expense reports are due within 30 days.
Full-time employees accrue 15 vacation days per year. Up to 5 unused days carry over. Balances are updated after each pay period.
Employee E001 has 8.5 vacation days remaining as of 2026-07-15.
Employee E002 has 12 vacation days remaining as of 2026-07-15.
